description: This source file contains unit tests for the WiFi-related functionalities of a NetworkManager plugin, utilizing Google Test framework. It tests methods such as WiFi disconnect, get connected SSID, WiFi state, and scanning functionalities, with extensive mocking of libnm, gobject, and internal behaviors.
